entries.proposition: This is described as the first reported gene-therapy use in this disorder, under compassionate use.
entries.snippet: This case represents the first reported use of gene therapy in a patient with SMA-PME

entries.proposition: Prophylactic immunosuppression was prednisolone plus sirolimus.
entries.snippet: Prophylactic immunosuppressive therapy included prednisolone and sirolimus (Figure 1A).
entries.anchor: Patient details and clinical findings, para 2

entries.proposition: Anti-AAV9 neutralising antibodies were absent at screening, but a low total IgG titre to the capsid was found retrospectively before dosing.
entries.snippet: whereas total low IgG antibodies were detected prior to vector injection
entries.anchor: Patient details and clinical findings, para 2

entries.proposition: Several cytokines were elevated before dosing, read by the authors as a pre-existing inflammatory state.
entries.snippet: These findings indicate a pre-existing inflammatory state prior to dosing.

entries.proposition: Postmortem examination: acute circulatory failure as cause of death, no overt myocarditis or thrombotic microangiopathy.
entries.snippet: Postmortem analysis identified acute circulatory failure as the cause of death, with no overt signs of myocarditis

entries.proposition: Vector copy number in CNS was 16- to 550-fold lower than liver.
entries.snippet: showing a 16- to 550-fold decrease compared to the liver

entries.proposition: Figure 3B: vector copies per diploid genome about 7700 in liver, 2450 in spleen, 850 in lung, 810 in kidney, against 14 in cerebellum, 128 in cortex and 493 in thoracic cord.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 3B bar chart read at native resolution: liver 7704, spleen 2448, lung 847, kidney 806, adrenal 466, left ventricle 374, cortex 128, cerebellum 14, thoracic spinal cord 493, lumbar dorsal root 460 vg per diploid genome.

entries.proposition: Acid ceramidase protein in CNS regions stayed below endogenous control levels at day 8 while peripheral tissues were higher.
entries.snippet: whereas they remained below endogenous levels in various regions of the CNS 8 days after vector injection

entries.proposition: The authors propose an early innate-immune, complement-mediated endothelial injury leading to capillary leak, shock and multi-organ failure.
entries.snippet: We propose a mechanism driven by the early innate immune response

entries.proposition: The authors state there were no features of thrombotic microangiopathy or atypical haemolytic uraemic syndrome, unlike earlier high-dose AAV9 reports.
entries.snippet: no features of TMA or aHUS were observed, suggesting a distinct pathophysiological profile

entries.proposition: The authors list multiple contributing factors and do not isolate one.
entries.snippet: Multiple factors likely contributed to this fatal outcome, including pre-existing inflammation, high vector dose, AAV serotype, intravenous delivery

entries.proposition: The authors say sirolimus did not appear to mitigate the early immune response, consistent with its mainly adaptive-immunity action.
entries.snippet: Importantly, sirolimus did not appear to mitigate early immune response in this patient

entries.proposition: The authors say the contribution of disease-related inflammation and recent bronchial congestion cannot be disentangled.
entries.snippet: Although the respective contributions of SMA-PME-related inflammation and recent bronchial congestion without documented infection remain difficult to disentangle

entries.proposition: Eculizumab was given on day 5 to prevent complement-driven platelet consumption, after the first signs; the authors note delayed initiation after cytokine-storm onset may reduce efficacy.
